ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
 select_oncall VARCHAR2(1) := 'N' ;
 select_unassign VARCHAR2(1) := 'N' ;
 hours number ;

 cursor c2 is 
 select to_date(:s_start_date,'MM-DD-RR') +rownum-1 temp_date
 from staff_schedule_details
 where rownum < (to_date(:s_end_date,'mm-dd-rr') - to_date(:s_start_date,'mm-dd-rr')) +2;

 cursor c1 is 
 select staff_no,initcap(last_name||', '||first_name) staff_name,team_id,facility_code
 from employees
 where emp_class = 'MSTAF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and :s_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:s_date+1)
 and facility_code=nvl(:control_block.s_facility,facility_code) 
 and not exists --IM 628
 (select pa.staff_no from pre_assignments pa
 where pa.staff_no = employees.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and :s_date BETWEEN TRUNC(pa.sys_bod) AND TRUNC(pa.sys_eod)
 ) 
 and not exists
 (select staff_no from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = :s_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C'))
 and staff_schedule_details.staff_no = employees.staff_no)
 and not exists
 (select staff_no from staff_off_day
 where staff_off_day.staff_no = employees.staff_no
 and unavail_date = :s_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and from_time is null
 and to_time is null)
 order by team_id ;
BEGIN
 begin 
 select 'Y' into select_oncall
 from staff_off_day
 where unavail_date between nvl(:s_date, to_date(:s_start_date,'mm-dd-rr'))
 and nvl(:s_date, to_date(:s_end_date, 'mm-dd-rr'))
 and reason = 'ONCAL'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1 ;
 go_block('on_call_staff') ;
 check_package_failure ; 
 execute_query ;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then 
 null ;
 when others then
 handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 go_block('EMPLOYEES') ;
 check_package_failure ;

 message('Working..',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE) ;--pitss synchronize ;

 if :s_date is not null then
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 :employees.sch_date := :s_date;
 :employees.sch_day := to_char(:employees.sch_date,'DY');
 :employees.staff_no := c1rec.staff_no ;
 :employees.staff_name := c1rec.staff_name;
 :employees.team_id := c1rec.team_id ;
 :employees.facility_code := c1rec.facility_code;
 get_employee_details ; 

 calc_hours_on_schedule(:employees.staff_no,
 :control_block.s_schedule_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 hours) ; 
 :employees.hours := round(hours,2) ;
 next_record ;
 select_unassign := 'Y' ;
 end loop ;
 else 
 for c2rec in c2
 loop
 :s_date := c2rec.temp_date;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 :employees.sch_date := :s_date;
 :employees.sch_day := to_char(:employees.sch_date,'DY');
 :employees.staff_no := c1rec.staff_no ;
 :employees.staff_name := c1rec.staff_name ;
 :employees.team_id := c1rec.team_id ;
 :employees.facility_code := c1rec.facility_code ; 
 get_employee_details ;
 calc_hours_on_schedule(:employees.staff_no,
 :control_block.s_schedule_id,
 :global.chapter_id,
 hours) ;
 :employees.hours := round(hours,2) ;
 next_record ;
 select_unassign := 'Y' ;
 end loop ;
 end loop;
 :s_date := null;
 end if;

 clear_message ;
 if select_unassign = 'Y' then
 clear_record ;
 first_record ;
 end if ;

 if select_oncall = 'N' and select_unassign = 'N' then
 show_error('12110');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 
 :control_block.data_retrieved := 'Y' ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_SCHEDULE_ID','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FACILITY','D') ;

 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.SCHD_LOV_BUTTON',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.RETRIEVE_BUTTON',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 set_item_property('CONTROL_BLOCK.FACILITY_LIST',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
END;

PROCEDURE get_home_phone (p_staff_no in varchar2) IS
 temp_address_id varchar2(10) ;
BEGIN
 select address_id into temp_address_id
 from employees
 where staff_no = p_staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 begin
 select decode(h_area_code,null,null,h_area_code||'-')||
 decode(h_phone_no,null,null,substr(h_phone_no,1,3)||'-'||substr(h_phone_no,4,4))
 into :home_phone
 from addresses
 where address_id = temp_address_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_HOURS_ON_SCHEDULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE show_hours_on_schedule (p_staff_no in varchar2) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 hours number := 0 ;
 cursor c1 is
 select drive_id from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no ;

BEGIN
 /*-- Count all the drives in the database --*/
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start)*24 ;
 end loop ;

 :EMPLOYEES.hours := round(hours,2) ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_HOURS_ON_SCHEDULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This procedure calculates the hours for a staff in a schedule. This considers piggybacks also.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

PROCEDURE calc_hours_on_schedule (p_staff_no in varchar2,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 hours out number) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 last_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 last_date date ;
 last_hours number ;
 last_start date ;
 pb_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 counter number := 0 ;
 cursor c1 is
 select ssd.drive_id,drive_date from staff_schedule_details ssd,drives
 where ssd.schedule_id = p_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and ssd.chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and drives.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 and drives.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 order by schedule_start_time asc ;
BEGIN
 hours := 0 ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 /*-- Check if this drive is piggybacked to the last one --*/
 if counter > 0 then
 if c1rec.drive_date = last_date then
 begin
 select drive_id into pb_drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = last_drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and drive_id != last_drive_id ;
 if pb_drive_id = c1rec.drive_id then
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 hours := last_hours + (act_end - last_start) * 24 ;
 act_end := act_start ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 last_hours := hours ;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start)*24 ;
 last_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 last_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 last_start := act_start ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
END;
